summary: First-iteration testing of CalibrationOS. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASS covering auth (owner/contractor/invalid), seeded shops & custom pricing, shop CRUD, zone detection (west <-112, east >-111.8), public booking flow (availability + book), Sunday/past/>21-day rejection, full job lifecycle (driving→on_site→complete with mock Xero invoice + SMS log), and role-based access control. Frontend: Owner login → /dashboard verified, Contractor login → /field verified, /shops shows all 3 seeded shops (Safelite, AutoGlassNow, Glass Doctor), /shops/new shows zone auto-detection on address blur (EAST VALLEY badge appears for Gilbert). Shop creation is multi-step (Continue to Terms & Sign → signature page) — full creation flow not fully traversed via UI but all underlying API paths confirmed working via backend tests.

issues: Sign In button has no type='submit' attribute on some renders — works via click but missing data-testid. Recommend adding data-testid='login-email', 'login-password', 'login-submit'

No data-testid attributes on form fields (name, address, signer, submit). Tests must rely on name/text selectors. Recommend adding data-testid='shop-name','shop-address','shop-terms-signer','shop-submit','booking-link'

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to Login form (login-email, login-password, login-submit) and Shop New form (shop-name, shop-address, shop-terms-signer, shop-submit) and booking-link element on success screen, plus action-start-driving / action-arrived / action-complete / result-pass / result-fail / doc-name on Field detail view, to enable robust automated UI testing as referenced in the spec.

Field view (/field) full lifecycle and Public booking multi-step UI were not exercised end-to-end via Playwright due to missing testids and multi-step flow complexity; API flow is fully verified. Main agent can self-test these UI flows after adding testids.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 770+ lines — consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/shops.py, routers/jobs.py, routers/public.py, services/mock_integrations.py for maintainability
JWT_SECRET falls back to 'calibrationos-dev-secret-change-me' if env missing — fine for MVP but flag for prod
/api/geocode is unauthenticated — minor info-leak risk, consider gating to owner
shop_price_for: if pricing_tier=='custom' and custom_rate is None it silently falls back to standard — acceptable but worth documenting
compute_available_slots assumes scheduled_end is ISO; if a previously inserted job is missing this field the algorithm would 500. Defensive parsing recommended.
All async DB writes use insert_one(payload.copy()) — good pattern preventing _id leak into response

success_rate.frontend: 70% (login + navigation + zone detect verified; multi-step shop create + field lifecycle UI not exercised due to missing testids)

test_credentials: Owner: caleb@thecalibrationcrew.us / Owner123!  Contractor: contractor@thecalibrationcrew.us / Contractor123! (also shown on login page)
seed_data_creation: Seed runs on startup: 1 owner, 1 contractor, 3 shops (Safelite-Gilbert east, AutoGlassNow-Goodyear west custom $115, Glass Doctor-Mesa east). Tests created TEST_-prefixed shops, jobs, and one mock Xero invoice — left in DB for next agent visibility.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_calibrationos.py covers all critical flows incl. full job lifecycle + Xero mock invoice + SMS log + custom pricing per-shop + zone detection. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_calibrationos.py -v. For frontend, after main agent adds data-testid attributes (see action_items), retest /shops/new multi-step submit (Continue to Terms & Sign → signer input → final submit → booking-link display) and /field full lifecycle (tap job → start-driving → arrived → result pass/fail + doc-name → submit → confirmation + invoice_id set).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All endpoints behaved per spec including correct zone mapping by longitude, drive-time aware slot generation, day/Sunday/horizon limits, custom shop pricing override, mock Xero invoice line items shape (calibration label + customer/vehicle/VIN line at $0), SMS kinds (booking_confirmed/on_my_way/completed), and contractor RBAC.
